summary: The AssessmentValidationResult class represents a validation result structure for assessing various conditions in an assessment process.
purpose: To encapsulate the results of various validation checks during an assessment process, indicating whether specific conditions are met.

fields.name: InterimWithoutFinal
fields.description: Indicates whether there is an interim assessment without a final assessment.

fields.name: InstructorsAndSupervisors
fields.description: Indicates whether both instructors and supervisors have been involved in the assessment process.

fields.name: AssessmentMaximumExceeded
fields.description: Indicates whether the maximum allowable assessments have been exceeded.

validations: Checks for the presence of an interim assessment without a final assessment.
Verifies the involvement of both instructors and supervisors in the assessment process.
Ensures that the number of assessments does not exceed the defined maximum.
conditions: Interim assessment exists without a corresponding final assessment.
Both instructors and supervisors are involved in the assessment.
Number of assessments should not exceed the maximum limit.
